nom: La Roche-Posay Anthelios Mineral Tinted Ultra Light Face Sunscreen Fluid SPF 50

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily/combination skin report a natural, non-greasy finish and reduced shine, though a few note a lingering greasy feel if too much is applied.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe it as hydrating-feeling and comfortable for daily wear, though one reports the skin turning dry and uncomfortable if not applied immediately after the rest of the skincare routine.
segments.combination: The one reviewer identifying as oily/combination found it reduced redness and evened tone but noted occasional greasiness with heavier application.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly report no irritation and gentle wear, but one reports a severe reaction with painful blisters around the nose, eyes and mouth.
segments.mature: Reviewers over 50 (including one at 63 and one at 80) report it works well as a lightweight foundation replacement, correcting redness and not settling into fine lines or wrinkles.
segments.normal: One reviewer describing normal-to-dry skin found the tint and coverage excellent with no greasy feel.

concerns.aging: Reviewers with mature or aging skin report the product does not settle into fine lines or wrinkles and gives a smoothing, glowy finish; no negative reports specific to aging skin were found.
concerns.dehydration: One reviewer with rosacea/sensitivity notes skin became very dry and uncomfortable if the product was not applied immediately after the rest of the routine, while others with dry skin describe it as comfortable and non-drying.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or reddish/pink undertones report the tint helps correct and reduce the appearance of redness; two reviewers with rosacea report no irritation after use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer describes a severe reaction with painful blisters, suggesting barrier compromise in at least one case, while most sensitive-skin reviewers report calm skin and no reaction.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report the tint helps blur and cover hyperpigmentation, dark marks, and scarring, offering a natural-looking coverage without heavy makeup.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers who mention breakouts report none, including one who says it never caused breakouts unlike other sunscreens; however, one reviewer with acne-prone skin reports new breakouts they attribute to difficulty fully removing the product, and another reports a reaction and clogged pores when sweating heavily.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers with oily skin report a matte-to-natural, non-greasy finish that controls shine, though a few others describe the texture itself as oily, greasy, or slow to dry down, especially when overapplied.

aspects.libelle: No white cast on deeper skin tones

extraits.texte: I am a cancer survivor, and I primarily use only clean products. After trying Wet n Wild, I had an allergic reaction. La Roche posay was suggested to me, claiming that it doesn't cause skin irritation. La Roche posay gave me painful blisters all over my face, around my nose, eyes, and mouth. I couldn't put anything on my face for days!!! DO NOT BUY!!!!

I was very excited to try this product as I've heard a lot of good things about it, but it just didn't work for me. It does have a lot of positives like the tint being really even and adding a nice bit of color. I'm someone who self tans so I know some people mentioned it being too dark, but it actually worked for me quite well. I also thought the oil absorbing technology did work fairly well for me. I think what some of the other reviewers were mentioning could be true if you're new to mineral sunscreens, but many of them pull shiny and this one was actually on a bit of the less shiny side. However, this product is extremely difficult to take off your skin. When I first tested it on my hand, I noticed water almost beaded off of it, which led me to believe this product's formula was almost waterproof. This in theory would be a really good quality, but when I would try to remove it at night, I struggled to do so. It felt like i could never fully get it off even with a double cleanse method. I started to get breakouts over time and atrributed this to not bejnf able to ever fully take the product off my skin causisng build up. I had to stop using. It's very difficult to find a good tinted mineral SPF with no fragrance and I wish this worked for me, but I would caution people against it if you're acne prone.

This sunscreen is good for daily ware to the office and home but if you are out walking and it's hot where you are sweating up a storm this sunscreen clogs up the pores and made my whole face have a reaction.

extraits.titre: Love the liquid consistency, wears like makeup
extraits.texte: I have rosacea, hypersensitivity, and no reactions after 3 days of use. Product is thin like liquid makeup and looks perfect, if you top with hawaiian tropic sunscreen powder. No settling in lines and wrinkles, 51 yrs old. Only complaint is it needs to be applied immediately after normal skincare routine. When I waited to apply, my skin became very dry and uncomfortable. I would expect the product to hydrate on its own. But I was able to resolve by applying with my routine.

It's pricey but completely worth it. No white cast, no orange tones, and it doesn't irritate or break out my sensitive, acne prone skin. I have light medium skin, and this is basically the perfect shade for me. When my skin is in good shape, this sunscreen doubles as foundation. When I have acne and scarring to cover, it adds some extra coverage. This sunscreen does such a great job of protecting my skin when I'm out and about, even when it's super hot out. I usually don't repurchase sunscreens, but I've bought at least five of this one.
Beautiful for mature, aging, pink/red, menopausal, dry skin. No need for foundation. So light you don't even know it's there. Love it!!

Never stop making this. I have oily skin and it gives a natural finish to my skin. Tint is perfect, i'm pale but it doesn't make me look yellow. I can use this as a skin tint since it evens out my face. LOVE LOVE LOVE!! Doesn't clog pores and lasts all day.
